source_grounding.call_chain_traced: PUT /collections/{name} {wal_config:{wal_retain_closed:0}} -> request DTO validation (WalConfigDiff has NO range attribute on wal_retain_closed, so 0 passes; wal_capacity_mb=0 is the field WITH range(min=1), explaining its 422) -> toc/create_collection.rs:148 update_opt resolves Some(0) over default 1 with no clamping and no .validate() on the resolved config -> Collection::new (collection/mod.rs:103) -> ShardReplicaSet::build (replica_set/mod.rs:139) -> LocalShard::build (local_shard/mod.rs:579) -> SerdeWal::new(&wal_path, (&config.wal_config).into()) (local_shard/mod.rs:659; the load path at :372 shares the same conversion) -> From<&WalConfig> for WalOptions (config.rs:52) -> NonZeroUsize::new(0).unwrap() PANICS 'called `Option::unwrap()` on a `None` value' (config.rs:62) -> panic contained in dispatcher.rs:259 tokio::task::spawn -> JoinError -> StorageError::service_error('Tokio task join error: task NNNN panicked with message ...') (errors.rs:332-334) -> HTTP 500; process survives, /healthz stays 200
source_grounding.outcome_note: The create-side WalConfigDiff carries no range validation on wal_retain_closed (config_diff.rs:87) while its sibling wal_capacity_mb does (line 82) - mirroring the documented min-0 grid - and the resolved WalConfig's range(min=1) (config.rs:43) is never enforced on the create path (no .validate() call in create_collection between diff resolution and Collection::new). The documented-legal boundary value 0 therefore reaches an unguarded NonZeroUsize::new(0).unwrap() (config.rs:62) whose panic message matches the observed 500 body byte-for-byte. NOT marked by_design_in_source: the unwrap carries no intent comment/docstring and no maintainer declaration is present; bare unannotated behavior is barred from by_design per the v3.4 tightening. The resolved-side range(min=1) shows the codebase itself considers <1 invalid for WalConfig, which makes the missing diff-side guard/clamp an omission, not a declared decision.
